role: independent borderline answer adjudicator; no summary repair

grading_standard.correct: All requested parts correct with no contradiction or unresolved caveat and supported by summary.
grading_standard.partial: Missing or unresolved requested part, no material contradiction.

interpretation_policy: Judge semantics, not prescribed pronoun vocabulary. Preserve the difference between granting power access/activating modifiers and defining whose events a power affects. A later explicit destination contradicting an earlier correct cycle is not silently rewritten into basis shorthand. adjudications.scope_reason: The question explicitly asks destinations. "Goes to the pile for" states a destination, not merely the basis of the next-region lookup. First, check for any modifications of the Travel cost to a specific number ... Then, modify it with any other Travel modifiers ... Any Travel modifier that says "Spend no Supply" completely overrides the Travel cost (7.6.2).
Powers that say "spend no Supply" ignore the Travel cost ... including any increases to it.
Site garrisons stay put; fixed-number cost first, other increases/decreases next, free Travel final override.

adjudications.scope_reason: The actual question asks base costs, facedown reveal and the interaction of fixed costs, increases and free Travel. B answers every one unequivocally. It does not say the interaction is unknown, decline to rule, or make the zero-cost result conditional. Its final caveat concerns unrequested enumeration of every possible modifier combination; it cannot reasonably negate the preceding universal free-Travel override. Therefore correct on the expressly requested ruling. If the fixed key is applied as an exhaustive checklist, missing site-garrison immobility makes the whole answer partial, as recorded in grade, rather than a caveat failure. This distinction preserves the key fact instead of silently relaxing it.
